_about: Public-domain R. A. Torrey (1856-1928, evangelist, first superintendent of the Moody Bible Institute) for the Word Hoard: How to Pray, The Person and Work of the Holy Spirit and Revival Addresses, clean from CCEL. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Filled out 2026-11-15 toward the R. A. Torrey Collection (15 vols) on Adam's Libronix list ('Libronix authors - reconciled.md', add-on RAT): every title of it that has an open pre-1930 scan or a Gutenberg text, plus How to Bring Men to Christ (1893).
